description: Jackson, MS – In case you missed it, as first reported by Mississippi Today, Pete Buttigieg is joining the list of national Democrats who are campaigning for District Attorney Scott Colom, because they know Mississippi is in play. Earlier this week, President Obama cut an ad for Colom and tomorrow, Senator Warnock will stump for Colom in Jackson. Senators Alsobrooks, Blunt Rochester, and Booker.
